observed.caption: People gather around a small lake with a yellow pedal boat in an urban park with palm trees and a city skyline of tall buildings under a clear blue sky.
observed.description: In the foreground a calm lake reflects the sky with a yellow pedal boat with a green canopy carrying two people near the center. The grassy shoreline is lined with palm trees, leafy green trees and a prominent leafless tree, with numerous small figures of people walking, sitting on the grass and gathering in groups. A brown giraffe sculpture stands near the shore on the right. Behind the park an elevated highway overpass runs horizontally across the middle ground. The background skyline features a tall cylindrical tower with a flat disc top on the left, several mid-rise buildings in the center, and a modern glass twin tower with gold accents and a smaller clock tower in front of it on the right. The sky is clear and bright blue with strong daylight illumination.
